frontmatter.sidebar_description: Update the tax lines of items and shipping methods in an order.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateOrderTaxLinesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow updates the tax lines of items and shipping methods in an order. It's used by
other order-related workflows, such as the [createOrderWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/createOrderWorkflow) to set the order's
tax lines.

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to update an
order's tax lines in your custom flows.

steps.name: setTaxLineContext
steps.description: This hook is executed after the cart is fetched and before tax lines are calculated. You can consume this hook to add custom context to the tax calculation. The returned object is set as the additional\_context property in the getItemTaxLinesStep input.

steps.name: getItemTaxLinesStep
steps.description:
This step retrieves the tax lines for an order or cart's line items and shipping methods.

:::note

You can retrieve an order, cart, item, shipping method, and address details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

steps.name: setOrderTaxLinesForItemsStep
steps.description:
This step sets the tax lines of an order's items and shipping methods.

:::note

You can retrieve an order's details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

children.description: The IDs of the items to update the tax lines for.

children.name: shipping_method_ids
children.description: The IDs of the shipping methods to update the tax lines for.

children.name: force_tax_calculation
children.description:
Whether to force the tax calculation. If enabled, the tax provider
may send request to a third-party service to retrieve the calculated
tax rates. This depends on the chosen tax provider in the order's tax region.

children.name: is_return
children.description: Whether to calculate the tax lines for a return.

children.name: shipping_address
children.description: The shipping address to use for the tax calculation.

children.name: rate_id
children.description:
The associated rate's ID.
When integrating with a third-party, you don't need to provide it.
This is mainly used for the built-in rates.

children.description: The rate of the tax line.

children.name: provider_id

children.name: data
children.description:
Additional data returned by the tax provider.
Use this to store jurisdiction-level breakdown data
(e.g. state, county, city rates) that is not captured in the aggregated rate.

blocks.html:
Hooks allow you to inject custom functionalities into the workflow. You'll receive data from the workflow, as well as additional data sent through an HTTP request.

Learn more about [Hooks](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/workflow-hooks) and [Additional Data](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/api-routes/additional-data).

This hook is executed after the order is fetched and before tax lines are calculated. You can consume this hook to add custom context to the tax calculation. The returned object is set as the additional\_context property in the getItemTaxLinesStep input.
Handlers consuming this hook accept the following input.
